about.title: ABOUT ME
about.subtitle: PROFILE
about.bio1: I'm Yago, a Fullstack developer based in Spain. I trained in the Higher Vocational Degree in Multiplatform Application Development (DAM) and I've been building software from end to end ever since.
about.bio2: I currently work at Nter Solutions, where I started on a training contract and moved to a permanent position. I'm comfortable on both frontend and backend, and I enjoy solving problems and keeping code clean and maintainable.
about.bio3: When I'm not coding, I keep learning new technologies and improving the way I work.

nter.title: Fullstack Developer
nter.desc: Currently working at Nter Solutions for 9 months. I've participated in projects with a wide variety of languages both in web development with technologies like React, SPFx and Python Dash, as well as applying parallel solutions focused on backend with technologies like Spring and other areas like systems administration with Azure and data and pipelines with Databricks.

uco.title: Internship — IT Department
uco.desc: 3-month internship (FCT) in the IT department of UCO. First contact with the professional environment, renewing the complete Docentia Application in which I participated fully developing both backend and frontend functions.

dam.title: Higher Degree — DAM
dam.desc: Higher Vocational Training program. A solid foundation in programming, databases, web development and cross-platform mobile apps.

project1.title: 8-bit Portfolio
project1.desc: This very portfolio: a retro experience built with React, Vite and GSAP. Parallax, smooth animations and a modular architecture.

calculator.title: Calculator App
calculator.desc: A simple calculator app for Android, built with Java for Android and XML. It features basic operations, a clean interface and responsive design.
